about_the_game:
Stardream is an immersive narrative game set in a retro-futuristic universe inspired by the 70s. You play as a taxi driver on an interstellar station, where each ride reveals unique stories. But everything changes the day a mysterious message from the past disrupts your routine, pushing you to uncover buried secrets.

Explore the station freely, enter detailed interiors, and discover intimate tales shared by your passengers. Every choice you make will shape your journey and the revelations that unfold.

Key Features:

  • Immersive Exploration: Travel through diverse and detailed environments aboard your space taxi, with the ability to visit iconic locations on the station.

  • Interactive Storytelling: Make decisions that shape the story, featuring rich dialogues and deep characters.

  • Retro-Futuristic Atmosphere: Dive into a world where 70s technology and design blend with a unique futuristic vision.

  • Mysteries to Uncover: An eerie message from the past turns your life upside down, leading you on an adventure full of secrets to uncover.

With its carefully crafted art direction, diverse gameplay mechanics, and captivating story, Stardream invites you to experience a narrative-driven adventure where every choice matters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 2300U
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600XT
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 Super or RX 5700XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: In Stardream, you play a taxi driver on a space ark. A mysterious message from the outside shakes society to its core. While the authorities try to hide everything, you embark on a risky investigation into a truth that should never have resurfaced.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
